alignment.understanding: Reduce Speech Blocks persistence from three artifacts (speech_blocks.json as a bare list, speech_blocks_report.json, speech_blocks_state.json) to a single authoritative speech_blocks.json document object, mirroring the Character Discovery single-document refactor (commit 1d8e718). Non-derivable fields (source kind/language/fingerprint, ai_profile_id, instructions, scene_ambience, response_contract, token_usage, budget_metadata, resume checkpoint, log path, blocks) are persisted once; report/state counts and warnings are recomputed on read via compatibility projections; the source_chunks text copy is removed and re-resolved from upstream. Functional behavior (generate, resume by chunk+segment, resplit, approvals, insert/delete, reset, export, manifest sync, character-edit locking) stays identical.

intent.statement: Simplify Speech Blocks persistence from 3 files (speech_blocks.json list + report + state) to a single authoritative speech_blocks.json document; drop redundant report/state duplication and the source_chunks text copy; keep functional behavior identical (generate, resume, resplit, approvals, export, manifest sync). Per plan 0_Planning/Speech_Blocks_Metadata_Simplification.md.

examples: After start_or_continue_generation, only speech_blocks.json exists in 70_speech_blocks/.
spec_items.statement: Speech Blocks writes exactly one artifact, speech_blocks.json, as a document object; speech_blocks_report.json and speech_blocks_state.json are never created.

examples: document has no 'source_chunks' key; load_input_source_chunks re-reads chunks_text.json/translated_text.json.
spec_items.statement: The Speech Blocks document does not persist upstream source-chunk text; only source.fingerprint is stored and source chunks are re-resolved from upstream artifacts.

examples: projected report counts == recomputed counts over the same blocks.
spec_items.statement: load_speech_blocks_report() and load_operation_state() return projections derived from the single document identical in shape and values (counts, warnings, stage/status, resume checkpoint, progress) to the previous separate artifacts.

examples: resume continues from an unfinished direct segment using document.checkpoint.
spec_items.statement: Resume reads next_chunk_index, active_chunk_id, next_segment_index, completed_segment_count, run_token and source.fingerprint from document.checkpoint so chunk- and segment-level resume behave identically.

examples: old list-format speech_blocks.json -> load_speech_blocks_document() is None.
spec_items.statement: A legacy list-format speech_blocks.json or a missing document is treated as not-started: load_speech_blocks_document returns None and no legacy report/state file is read or converted.

examples: after reset, none of the three files remain.
spec_items.statement: reset_speech_blocks removes the single document and any residual legacy speech_blocks_report.json / speech_blocks_state.json files so the operator can regenerate cleanly.
